title: L105 — THE FIFTH CONFIRMATION
voice: Two traders see the same signal fire. One takes it in under a minute, but the other is still checking.
A fourth confirmation appears, then a fifth, and the setup is already gone by the time he's satisfied.
Every confirmation arrives after the move that produced it, so each one he waits for is paid in distance already travelled.
Certainty was never the missing piece — it was the excuse that kept arriving on time.

caption:
Two traders see the same signal. One takes it in under a minute — the other is still checking a fifth confirmation when it's already gone.

He isn't waiting because the signal is unclear. He's waiting because acting on it feels irreversible, and one more check always feels safer than the click. Certainty was never the missing piece.
